newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products softer across the board.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products softer across the board.

text.p: NWE oil products were softer across the board on Monday, traders said.
Weaker gasoline sentiment left swap values $2 lower and barges around $3 weaker as dealers referred to a better supplied market and a perception that the market was overvalued.
Lower crude futures helped to push down naphtha swaps by around $1 in a quiet start.
Gas oil prices slipped $1.75 across the board in line with the September IPE gas oil contract which was trading at $169.50. Spreads were stable.
